breaking.change: A `touch` binding no longer takes a zone: it reads a touch anywhere on the play surface. A touch in one part of the screen has one model, the on-screen button the UI lays out (a View with `touchButton`), which also shows its press. A saved binding's `zone` is ignored.
breaking.fix: Drop the binding's `zone` and put a View with `touchButton="<action>"` over that part of the screen on the HUD (`absolute` with the zone's fractions as percent insets, such as `absolute left-1/2 top-0 w-1/2 h-full` for the right half). No codemod: the replacement is a node in the game's UI tree, not an edit of the binding.
